summary: Implemented Parts A and B across 6 of 7 phases. Part B: tightened orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh's plan-cache write guard to real-dispatch-only and folded --force-phases into the cache key. Part A: added a whole_tree_claim admission dimension to orchestrate-batch-admit.sh by relabeling the collision scan's own sentinel-vs-sentinel exact match in place -- an implementation-time design finding showed the plan's literal 'separately-evaluated last dimension' could never reach that case, since the existing exact-match scan intercepts it first -- plus the reserved __WHOLE_TREE__ sentinel constant, the producer-side plan-format.md/planner-agent.md declaration obligation, and full mechanism/non-goal documentation. Also fixed a real coverage gap found while documenting Phase 4: orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh had no whole_tree_claim case arm and would have silently mis-ledgered every such defer into the unrecognized bucket. Phase 7 (redeploy + full gate) self-blocked correctly: the shared working tree carried 62-64 live, uncommitted sibling-task edits from concurrent dispatches in this same batch invocation at phase entry, and deploying now would sweep them into .claude/ -- exactly the hazard this task exists to prevent. A scoped verification tier covering everything this task touched (three test suites plus test-conflict-predicate.sh, all green; bash -n on all 8 touched scripts; doc-lint and task-reference lint clean) was run per this dispatch's own Batch Gate Deferral directive.

blockers.description: Phase 7's redeploy step is blocked on the shared working tree being clear of other tasks' uncommitted edits in this same /orchestrate batch invocation. Re-check git status --porcelain; once clean, run the whole-tree regeneration and the full gate set (verify-deploy.sh with no narrowing, run-all.sh with no --only), confirm deployed copies match the source store, then mark Phase 7 [COMPLETED].
blockers.resume_command: git status --porcelain && timeout 540 bash .claude/scripts/deploy-headless.sh && bash .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh && bash agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/run-all.sh && bash agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/validate-state.sh

artifacts.summary: Final-phase handoff: redeploy self-blocked on live sibling-task edits; resume command and full six-phase summary for a context-free successor.
